row.notes: 5-byte jmp thunk into .data1 body 0x150dc4ad0. For the vehicle's tyre component (*(*(tyre_rules+0xd8)+0x28)[vehicle]+0x10, cast to the tyre component type when that type derives from the component base) it takes the weekend allocation at +0x9c68 and tries the five compound slots in preference order (preference[0..4], slot = index into the allocation's five set vectors): a slot passes when it has a set the least-worn picker 0x142e8ab90 accepts (usable now: flags and session tag, see Sess_TyreAllocation_OnSessionStart) whose highest wheel wear is below max(wear_scale, the rules' wear limit); returns that set's slot (+0x04), else logs WARN 'Unable to get Closest Available Compound for vehicle %u.' and returns 0xffffffff. Callers: the human entering the garage (0x142a3b7a0), AI run planning (0x142f66cf0, 0x143693080); a 0xffffffff result fits nothing. Bound through the call at 0x142a3ba4c (rel32).
